title: Grade 2 Science — Thu, Jun 19
description: Our Food — Day 4 of 5: Healthy foods and junk food
subject: science

questions.question: Which of these is a HEALTHY food?
options: Fresh fruits like apple or banana
questions.explanation: Fresh fruits are healthy — they give us vitamins, minerals, and natural sugars. Chips, cold drinks, and candy are junk foods.

questions.question: Junk food is food that has too much:
questions.explanation: Junk food has too much sugar, salt, and oil (fat) and very few nutrients. It is tasty but not healthy.

questions.question: Why should we eat vegetables every day?
options: They give us vitamins and minerals that keep us healthy
They are expensive so they are nutritious
questions.explanation: Vegetables are rich in vitamins and minerals that protect us from diseases and keep our bodies working well.

questions.question: Which drink is the healthiest?
options: Packaged fruit juice with added sugar
questions.explanation: Water is the healthiest drink. Our body is about 70% water. We need 6–8 glasses of clean water every day.

questions.question: Eating too much junk food can cause:
questions.explanation: Too much sugar and fat in junk food leads to weight gain and tooth decay. It can also cause tummy problems.

questions.question: Which of these is a healthy breakfast?
options: Upma with vegetables + glass of milk
questions.explanation: Upma (made from semolina) + vegetables + milk gives carbohydrates, vitamins, and calcium — a complete healthy breakfast.

questions.question: Skipping meals (not eating on time) is:
options: Unhealthy — the body does not get energy on time
Fine as long as you eat once a day
questions.explanation: Skipping meals is unhealthy. The body needs regular food to get energy for thinking and playing.

questions.question: Dal, rice, vegetables, curd, and salad together make a ___.
questions.explanation: A balanced meal has all food groups — carbohydrates (rice), protein (dal), vitamins (vegetables), and calcium (curd).

questions.question: Which snack is HEALTHIER than chips?
questions.explanation: Roasted chana (chickpeas) is rich in protein and fibre. It is much healthier than chips, biscuits, or candy.

questions.question: How many times a day should we eat?
options: As many times as we want
questions.explanation: Children should eat 3 main meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner) and 1–2 healthy snacks to keep energy levels up all day.

questions.question: Why is washing our hands before eating important?
options: It removes germs and prevents illness
No reason — it is just a habit
questions.explanation: Our hands carry germs (bacteria) that can make us sick. Washing hands with soap removes germs before we touch food.

questions.question: Which of these foods helps us grow strong bones and teeth?
questions.explanation: Milk, curd, and paneer are rich in calcium, which is essential for strong bones and healthy teeth.

questions.question: Fruits and vegetables are called 'protective foods' because they:
options: Protect us from diseases with their vitamins and minerals
questions.explanation: Fruits and vegetables contain vitamins (A, C, B) and minerals that protect the body from illness. They boost our immunity.

questions.question: What is the main problem with drinking too many cold drinks (soda)?
options: Too much sugar causes weight gain and tooth decay
They are too cold to digest
questions.explanation: Cold drinks are loaded with sugar. Regular consumption leads to weight gain, tooth decay, and risk of diabetes.

questions.question: Which of these children is following HEALTHY eating habits?
options: Ravi who eats chips for every meal
Priya who eats fruits, vegetables, dal, and rice daily
Mohan who only drinks cold drinks
Sita who skips breakfast every day
questions.explanation: Priya eats a balanced diet — fruits, vegetables, dal (protein), and rice (carbohydrate). This is the healthiest habit.
